name: motrix-next
body:
## What's Changed

This beta adds filename previews and completed-file renaming, repairs browser activation and download confirmations, and bundles Aria2 Next 2.8.3 for all six desktop targets.

### ✨ New Features

- Preview and edit filenames before downloading, with an optional remote filename lookup.
- Rename completed single-file downloads from task details, with collision protection and recoverable history updates.
- Choose one browser-download behavior: confirm first, download in the background, or show Rayburst.

- Fixed empty captures clearing the clipboard. Empty recognition results now still run table and document detection on the captured image before the capture is treated as empty.
- Fixed watch mode repeatedly re-running OCR and AI requests on unchanged frames whose recognition produced no text.
- Fixed OCR captures appearing unresponsive while recognition was running.
- Fixed empty automation and capture history inputs being processed.

name: dsh-vision-router
body:
# v2.2.5

DSH Vision Router 2.2.5 is a privacy and Desktop multi-plugin isolation update for the DSH 0.1.7 line.

## Highlights

- Adds **Local-only vision / 仅本地视觉**. When enabled from the local Settings page, Vision Router permits only loopback visual endpoints (`localhost`, `127.0.0.0/8`, `::1`) and fails closed against configured cloud/DSH vision providers and the built-in anonymous OVHcloud fallback. Saved cloud configuration is preserved, and disabling the policy restores the previous chain. This policy covers Vision Router visual egress only; a remote chat model can still receive the resulting text.
- Fixes the remaining `dsh-vision-router@2.2.4` Windows Desktop multi-plugin startup hang reported in #551. The local/auth route boundary no longer leaves a replacement `webServer.register` on Cordis's shared WebServer service for the DVR fiber lifetime. DVR now shadows only its own injected child-context WebServer view, so unrelated plugins keep the original registrar while DVR-owned routes retain the same Host-auth/local capability checks.

- Keeps the public minimum supported DSH Host at `0.1.0-rc.8`; no settings migration is required.

body:
## What's New in v0.8.4 / 新版本特性

### 🌟 Highlights & Special Notes / 特别说明

#### English:

> ⭐ **Star from Links**: Paste any text or Markdown that mentions GitHub repositories into the new "Star from links" dialog, preview each repository's description, language, stars, and starred status, then star the ones you pick — up to 50 at a time, with per-repository results (PR #408).
>
> 🎛️ **Discovery Channel Management**: Hide discovery channels you don't use (such as X or Telegram) straight from the sidebar, on both desktop and mobile. At least one channel always stays enabled (PR #403).
>
> 🔍 **Smarter Release Asset Filters**: Custom filters now support keyword blacklists, per-filter "always include" and "always exclude" repository lists, and optional include keywords. The filter editor is reorganized into Assets and Repositories tabs, and multi-filter results are predictable: within one filter, exclusion wins; across filters, any match shows the release (PR #405, #409, #411).
>
> 🪟 **Update Dialog Polish**: The "New Version Available" dialog is wider, keeps the title and buttons in place while the changelog scrolls, and auto-hides its scrollbar (PR #406).
>
> 🛠️ **Fullstack Deployment Fix**: In the fullstack image, every GitHub API call now honors the network routing setting, and the server's CSP allows browser-direct GitHub/AI origins — fixing login and sync failures ("Failed to fetch") and missing avatars (PR #410).

#### 中文：

> ⭐ **从链接 Star 仓库**：新增「从链接 Star」功能，把提到 GitHub 仓库的文本或 Markdown 直接粘贴进来，预览每个仓库的描述、语言、Stars 和已 Star 状态，勾选后一键 Star——单次最多 50 个，每个仓库单独反馈结果（PR #408）。
>
> 🎛️ **发现频道管理**：可以在侧栏直接隐藏用不到的发现频道（如 X、Telegram），桌面端和移动端都支持，且始终保留至少一个频道（PR #403）。
>
> 🔍 **Release 资产过滤器更强大**：自定义过滤器现在支持关键词黑名单、按过滤器设置「始终包含」和「始终排除」的仓库列表，包含关键词也可以留空。过滤编辑弹窗重排为「资产 / 仓库」两个标签页，多过滤器规则更可预期：同一过滤器内排除优先，多个过滤器之间任一命中即显示（PR #405、#409、#411）。

name: Bili23-Downloader
body:
## 2.20.0 (2026-09-27)
### 新增
- 开启监控剪贴板后，启动时自动识别剪贴板中的链接
- 命名规则改为可视化编辑，一条规则即可同时适配单P与多P视频，多P稿件不再丢失主标题
- 通过 MCP 服务解析剧集时，支持获取链接所指向的视频
- 仅下载音频流时，统一对文件进行转封装
- 因网络错误下载失败的任务会自动重新排队重试，间隔逐次延长（30 秒起，最长 5 分钟），列表中显示重试倒计时；可在设置中关闭或调整次数。仅对网络类错误生效，手动暂停的任务不受影响

### 优化
- 为 Windows 构建版本添加数字签名
- 优化命名规则编辑器的布局与片段编辑体验，片段支持左右移动
- 所选编码不存在时将醒目提示实际下载编码
- 首次启动时自动检测出口地区无需再手动设置地理位置
- 港澳台地区改用国内 CDN 提供商
- 视频流与音频流的下载选项也能在设置界面中调整，不再需要先发起一次下载；这些选项改为随配置保存，重启后仍然保留
- 会员购课程的命名规则并入课程，不再单独列为一个内容类型

### 修复
- 修复部分视频无法获取到 1080P 画质的问题
- 修复部分情况下未下载完成仍然判定为下载完成的问题
- 修复部分视频合并时不显示合并进度的问题
- 修复 FFmpeg 无响应时任务一直停留在合并中，导致后续任务无法合并的问题
- 修复程序异常退出后，已下载完成的任务仍显示为下载中的问题
- 修复主窗口最小化到托盘或静默启动时，关闭下载选项对话框会导致程序自行退出的问题
- 修复海外 CDN 列表中 Akamai 节点始终返回 403 的问题，该节点已从默认列表移除
- 修复部分情况下下载地址只探测了一部分就报告解析失败的问题，现在会探测完全部候选节点；探测失败时的提示也改为按节点数说明，不再出现"共 24 个候选，已尝试 12 个"这类看不出所以然的说法
- 修复历史记录中出现未知的内容类型时，下载提示会显示一段 Python 内部变量名而不是可读原因的问题

### 注意
由于 2.20.0 的命名规则重构，升级后原先设置的命名规则将会丢失，需要重新设置。
> [!CAUTION]
> 强烈建议仅通过官方 GitHub 链接（即本页面下方的链接）下载本软件。 从第三方网站、网盘论坛或他人私下分享渠道获取的安装包，极有可能被二次篡改或植入病毒/木马。对于因下载、运行非官方渠道安装包所导致的任何设备损坏、隐私泄露或财产损失，开发者概不负责。

> [!TIP]
> Windows 7 以及低于 Windows 10 1809 的用户，请下载 Win 7 兼容版（带有 for_win7 字样）
> 其他问题请参考 [常见问题(FAQ)](https://bili23.scott-sloan.cn/doc/faq.html)

name: oh-my-openagent
body:
A patch release for problems people hit on 5.0.0. `omo update` installs it, or run:

```bash
bun add -g omo-ai
```

### Changed

**OmO Native moves to senpi 2026.9.27.** ([#8906](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/8906), [senpi#2157](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2157)) The fixes below come with it. npm, pnpm and Yarn installs now run on Bun when Bun 1.4.0 or newer is installed, the way `bun add -g` installs already did; set `OMO_RUNTIME=node` to stay on Node.js. When OmO Native does start on Node.js, it says once per version how to move to Bun.

**A local `omo` install now tells you to update with bun.** The launcher that `oh-my-openagent install` writes for a local checkout answered `omo update` with `npm i -g omo-ai`; it now prints `bun add -g omo-ai` (`omo-ai@beta` on a prerelease build), like every other install instruction. Installs from npm keep getting the npm command from `omo update`.

**`writing` leads with Claude Opus 5.5 at `low` and no longer runs on Claude Fable 5.1.** ([#8907](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/8907)) The builtin `writing` chain is now `claude-opus-5-5` (low), then `claude-opus-4-6` (max), on both OmO Native and the OpenCode edition, with the same Claude providers as before. It stays Claude-only: with neither model connected the category is unavailable instead of falling back to another family, so a setup whose only Claude model is Fable 5.1 no longer offers `writing` unless you pin `categories.writing.model`. A `writing` entry in your own config still wins over the default.

### Fixed

**Extensions load on Bun 1.3.x again.** ([senpi#2164](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2164), reported by @odurif0) An extension that declared its package directory as the entry (`"pi": { "extensions": ["."] }`) or depended on a package that requires a JSON file (ajv does) failed with `Cannot find module 'file:/…'`. name: macshot
body:
### Added

- **Press R to restore the last area**: on the capture screen, before selecting, R brings back your previous selection. Thanks @defia. (#359)
- **More filename tokens and date folders**: `{app}`, `{yyyy}`, `{MM}`, `{dd}`, `{HH}`, `{mm}`, `{ss}` and `{ms}`, and a `/` in the template files screenshots into subfolders, e.g. `{yyyy}/{MM}/{dd}/{app}-{HH}.{mm}.{ss}`. Thanks @mdtoupin. (#422)

### Improved

- **Much faster capture on multiple displays**: displays are captured one after another, the one under the pointer first, and each appears as soon as it is ready (reported 4.2 s down to 0.2 s on four displays). Thanks @mjjjjaazing. (#349)

### Changed

- **macshot has a new developer signature.** After this update, macOS may ask you once to allow Screen Recording for macshot again (and Accessibility or Input Monitoring if you use element snapping, keystrokes or click highlights). Your settings, history and recordings stay as they are. If macshot already looks switched on in System Settings but capturing does not work, select macshot there, remove it with the minus button (−), then add it back with the plus button (+). Technical users can instead run `tccutil reset ScreenCapture com.sw33tlie.macshot.macshot` (offline version: `com.sw33tlie.macshot.offline`) and relaunch macshot.
- The permission window now tells returning users how to remove and re-add macshot, since switching it off and on does not restore access after a signature change.

body:
#### 🚀 新增 - **Android TV 订阅导入**：全新设计好用的 Android TV 端添加订阅界面，扫码即可秒速导入配置 - **局域网用户认证**：为局域网连接（allow-lan）新增身份验证支持，提供专属管理界面，可配置多用户访问凭据 - **代理列表自动吸顶**：代理节点长列表支持自动吸顶标题，分组滚动时标题常驻置顶，可在菜单中自定义开启 - **WebDAV 多版本备份与加密**：云端备份支持历史版本管理与选择性恢复，并新增轻量加密以保护敏感账号密码 - **流媒体测试**：媒体解锁检测新增 **YouTube Music** 解锁测试项及专属图标 - **延迟动画与预览**：新增代理延迟动画实时选择与预览功能，并扩充添加超多种精美可选动画 - **macOS 常驻 Dock**：macOS 端应用设置新增“常驻 Dock”选项，支持按需保留或隐藏程序坞图标 (by argsno) - **Windows 便携版**：正式支持 Windows 便携版（Portable），配置数据放置于同级目录，并附带主动清理工具（`Clean.bat`） #### ⚡ 优化 - **默认网络栈调整**：使用新的 MIPStack 作为默认网络栈模式，进一步提升网络传输表现 - **连通性检测图标**：完善并美化连通性检测图标 (by AIsouler) - **小组件节能优化**：新增自动刷新开启时的连通性检测小部件节能逻辑，降低后台资源消耗 - **Android 17适配与沉浸式**：适配 Android 17 系统权限与跨用户场景，优化 Edge-to-Edge 沉浸边缘与主题样式 - **Windows 服务检查优化**：优化 Windows Helper 辅助服务的状态检测与端口连接检测逻辑，提升启动稳定性 - **设置界面视觉调整**：优化设置页面内嵌操作按钮（Inline Action Buttons）的样式与布局间距 - **桌面端设置项精简**：优化桌面端设置层级，移除/隐藏不适用的移动端选项，精简工具箱界面 #### 🐛 修复 - **桌面端扫码导入**：修复桌面端二维码添加订阅失效的问题 (by Catapult291) - **多显示器窗口修复**：修复桌面端双屏显示器模式下重启界面溢出的问题 - **内核启动日志修复**：修复部分场景下的内核启动日志显示报错问题 - **Code-forge**：修复内置编辑器在特定场景下光标与输入内容错位的问题，优化滚动与渲染 - **解锁测试修复**：修复 Google Gemini 的解锁测试检测逻辑，适配最新的响应规则 #### 🔧 内核 - **Mihomo 内核同步**：同步最新内核源码，改进 MIPS 表现以及增强负载均衡算法，完善 OpenVPN 等 # Bettbox 正式版本发布

name: Clash-for-Windows_Chinese
body:
### Clash for Windows 优化版
尝试借助 Agent 的力量对被混淆的代码逆向, 重构, 改进!

***

**`Clash.for.Windows.Setup_Opt-4.exe`使用说明:**
* 按照一般流程安装/更新
* 透过该安装程序安装的Clash for Windows将会劫持内置更新，因此更新可以选择在软件内完成

**`Clash.for.Windows-Opt.4-win.7z`, `Clash.for.Windows-Opt.4-win32-arm64.7z`使用说明:**
* 解压后运行Clash for Windows.exe开始使用

**`Clash.for.Windows-Opt.4-linux-arm64.tar.gz`, `Clash.for.Windows-Opt.4-linux-x64.tar.gz`使用说明 (Ubuntu):**
* 将解压后的源码文件夹放入目标目录
* 运行目录里的 `install-desktop-entry.sh` (这可以在应用列表里创建正确的图标)
* 开始使用 / 运行目录里的 `cfw` 开始使用

**MacOS使用说明:**
* 确保安装了 nodeJs
* 克隆 [main](https://github.com/Z-Siqi/Clash-for-Windows_Chinese/tree/main) 仓库
* 打开终端 cd 到该目录
* 运行 `npm run package:dmg:mac-arm64` (以 M 系列芯片为例)
* 运行结束后应该就可以在应用列表中看到了 (或搜索到)

如果不会的话可以下载 Codex 然后让 AI 自动给你构建

> 由于 Apple 开发者的年费贵到~用爱发电~支付不了, 因此无法提供可公开分发的 MacOS 安装包, 故而只能手动构建安装

***
#### 更新内容：

* 重构所有代码到基本可读的地步 (由 Codex 处理).
* 默认设置使用 Mihomo 核心 (可在设置页面中切换回旧版 Clash) #276 
* 兼容 AnyTLS & Hysteria2 协议.
* 使项目代码更加透明以便于贡献代码或进行审计 (当前的副作用是提升了安装包大小, 因为没再混淆/压缩代码, 按原样提供).
* 移除 @fndroid/network-interface 依赖因其含有无法审查安全性的 .node 预编译文件.
* 修复潜在的安全漏洞 (由 Codex 处理) 以提升安全性.
* 更新 Electron 到 v44.4.4
* 更新了其它依赖.
* 添加了端口被占用时的对话框 #213 
* 修复了更新 Electron 到 v34.0.0 以上导致 Ctrl+V 粘贴快捷键在 code-editor 失效的问题 #258 
* 修复了使用快捷键 显示/隐藏仪表板，窗口一闪而过 #292 
* 支持手动构建 MacOS 版本 (因 99 美元的 Apple 开发者年费被迫放弃可公开分发的安装包, 有谁能赞助嘛 QAQ)

> **可能有很多 breaking changes, 如果你发现了问题请通过 issue 等方式告知.**

***
欢迎帮助我改进，或有其它什么问题请在[这里向我提问](https://github.com/Z-Siqi/Clash-for-Windows_Chinese/issues/new/choose), 或是[查看以往的问题](https://github.com/Z-Siqi/Clash-for-Windows_Chinese/issues)。
当然也更欢迎直接发起 [Pull request](https://github.com/Z-Siqi/Clash-for-Windows_Chinese/pulls) 以更高效的解决问题!

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 由于 Electron 结束了(或即将结束)对 Windows x86 和 Windows 7 的支援, 考虑到停留在旧版可能增加的安全风险, 搭载 Windows x86 系统或运行 Windows 7 的系统将不再可安装使用该版本和以后的版本

name: lnreader
body:
This release adds shared-link support, crash reporting, and more control over categories and background tasks, along with safer backup restores and a round of stability fixes.

### New features

- Open a novel directly, or search for it, by sharing its URL to LNReader.
- Find crash logs and diagnostic details in Advanced settings to help troubleshoot issues.
- Set category selection to "Always ask" to choose categories each time you add a novel to your library.
- Show optional continue reading buttons on novel covers and list items in the library.
- Cancel any queued or running background task individually from the task queue.

### Improvements

- Refined the custom code editor, snippet controls, genre taxonomy screen, and statistics layout.
- Reduced background task memory usage and improved task lifecycle management.
- Backup restores are now non-destructive and preserve existing data where appropriate.
- Updated translations.

### Fixes

- Fixed crashes when chapter or novel names are missing.
- Fixed blank or empty-state flashes when opening the chapter drawer and novel screen.
- Fixed bottom navigation icons shifting when switching tabs.
- Fixed text-to-speech handling of dash-only dividers and surrounding quotation marks.
- Fixed newline handling in the code editor and restored the broken preview.

name: koodo-reader
body:
## New Features

- Support for exporting notes, highlights, and new vocabulary in JSON format
- Support for re-importing notes, highlights, and new vocabulary in JSON and CSV formats; go to Settings > Data
- Optimized rendering speed when handling large numbers of notes and highlights; no more lag issues
- Support for using AI to extract book titles and author names from filenames; right-click on a book and select “Edit Book”
- Support for using AI to parse book titles and authors from filenames when importing books; go to Settings > General
- Supports caching full-text translation and OCR results; books will load directly from the cache the next time they’re opened
- Added Paragraph Mode, Reading Ruler, and Speed Reading Mode; enable them in the reading options panel on the right
- Supports streaming parsing of CBZ and CBT books; no longer requires loading the entire book into memory, significantly improving book import and opening speeds
- Online book metadata matching now includes publication date, ISBN, ratings, and other information
- Copying text from books now preserves the original text formatting
- Added 100 curated book and app background images; go to Settings > Background Images
- Added 11 public domain dictionaries; go to Settings > Local Dictionaries
- Added export progress tracking for batch book exports
- Supports searching for books using a book key
- Restored support for custom TTS plugins, with added security warnings
- Experimental support for total page count; enable this in the reading options panel on the right
- Added page number display to the book table of contents, please enable total page count first
- The official AI dictionary now supports more target languages
- Added a “Return” button after navigating to a section via the inb-book table of contents
- (Mobile) The iOS version now supports accessing the system dictionary, system translation, and system OCR; go to Settings > Third-Party Services
- (Mobile) Optimized

name: wBlock
body:
## What's Changed

### Filter Lists & Onboarding
-   **Leaner Recommended Preset (`91724476`, `e681ef04`, `61639169`, #862, #863, #864)**
    EasyPrivacy, Adblock Warning Removal List, and Online Malicious URL Blocklist are no longer turned on by onboarding. AdGuard Tracking Protection and the base lists already cover them, and the first two stay in the catalog.
-   **Online Malicious URL Blocklist Retired (`1842fce5`, #864)**
    Safari's Safe Browsing already checks the same URLhaus data. If you had it on, it's kept as a custom list; otherwise it's removed.
-   **AdGuard Mobile Filter in the iOS Minimal Preset (`2b4de2ac`, #866)**
    The Minimal preset on iPhone and iPad now includes AdGuard Mobile Filter.
---
### Performance & Reliability
-   **Safari Memory on iOS (`5c722bfc`, #861)**
    Removed iframes are released instead of being kept alive by wBlock's content script, which could get Safari killed for memory on heavy pages like Speedometer.
-   **Scripts Extension Crash on macOS (`4e25b495`, #867)**
    The Scripts extension no longer holds the update lock while staging, so macOS doesn't kill it when it's suspended.
-   **Phantom Filter Updates (`8b6268ba`)**
    Pending updates that could never apply, such as the retired malicious URL list, are pruned instead of showing up as an update on every check.
-   **Filter List Sorting on iOS (`cbc1106e`, #860)**
    The filter list is sorted off the main thread.
-   **Smoother macOS Lists (`65138bee`, `e638390f`)**
    Filter and userscript lists scroll smoothly with bounce restored, and row heights are kept across searches and window resizes.
---
### Bug Fixes
-   **Site Settings (`542bce12`)**
    IP addresses and local hostnames are accepted.
-   **Userscript Sync (`5dee3dad`)**
    Custom names and descriptions for URL userscripts now sync.
-   **Sharp Safari Toolbar Icon (`c2e3ecec`, #858)**
    The toolbar shield is drawn from vector geometry at every size instead of an upscaled bitmap, so it's no longer blu

name: superpowers
body:
`writing-plans` produces leaner plans, faster. Plans now record the decisions an implementer needs (signatures, test assertions, the spec's values) instead of writing out the code. Some frontier models, including Opus 5.5, could get overzealous during plan writing and, with certain prompting, would sometimes try to implement the entire project while designing the plan. The new skill keeps planning focused on the plan. When we reproduced the original report, the scratch builds went away, and plans took a quarter of the time and about a third of the tokens. Thanks to Harper Reed for the report and session bundle. (#2333)

### Writing Plans

- **A plan records decisions. It's not a transcript of the code.** "What a Step Contains" replaces the "No Placeholders" section. A test step names the test and its assertions. A code step gives the exact signature, the file, and the spec's values, and includes a body only for an algorithm those don't determine. A verification step gives the command and its passing output. A reference to another task goes through that task's Interfaces block. Placeholders are still called out as the opposite failure. (#2333)
- **Self-review checks proportion.** The plan compares its own length to the spec's. A plan several times longer than the spec is a transcript, and when code blocks dominate, bodies get replaced with signatures and test assertions. (#2333)
- **The plan's reader is described as capable:** an engineer who writes idiomatic code once they know the exact interface and test. This replaces "zero context, questionable taste." Steps are now sized as "one action with a checkable result" instead of "2-5 minutes." (#2333)
- Every plan written by the new skill executed 9/9 against planted-defect probes on Sonnet 5, the same result as full-code plans. (#2333)
- Removed `plan-document-reviewer-prompt.md`. Nothing referenced it. (#2333)

- Removed `CLAUDE.md`. Claude Code now reads `AGENTS.md` directly, but only when no `CLA

A patch release: copied workflow packs load cleanly, and release notes now come from this changelog.

### Fixed

- A workflow pack copied into a project with `archon plugin copy` no longer reports a load error for a YAML file at the pack's root, such as an example config. A directory that holds `archon-plugin.json` is read only by the pack loader, so installed and copied packs load the same tree the same way. (#3505, #3512)
- Release notes on GitHub are built from this changelog's section for the version, with breaking changes first, instead of being replaced by generated notes. (#3518)

- 峰谷红绿灯支持中国法定节假日：落在工作日的法定假日全天显示谷电，调休上班的周末仍按谷电计（#152）。内置 2026 年假期表，超出范围时会在灯的说明里提示。
- 「下次切换」会跳过连续假期（例如国庆），直接指向假期后第一个工作日的 09:00。
- 红绿灯只在当前选择的是 DeepSeek 模型时显示。
- Windows 桌面版收起侧栏后，红绿灯移到标题栏里显示，不再被裁掉。
- 桌面版宽侧栏：立绘与「新会话」的悬停框重新对齐；Windows 标题栏下的「插件」行不再被立绘压住；macOS 上 DSH 字标不再压住窗口按钮。

### 安装与文档
- README 重新整理：安装步骤放在最前，细节收进折叠区；新增从 GitHub 源安装的方式。
- 说明 npm 新版发布后约 24 小时内 `update` 会停在上一版，以及想马上更新时用 `@^版本号` 安装的方法。

详情：[PR #153](https://github.com/Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale/pull/153) · [PR #154](https://github.com/Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale/pull/154) · [PR #155](https://github.com/Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale/pull/155)

---

## 0.1.5 更新

### DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 适配
- 深海女仆工坊与 ORCA LINK 适配 DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`（皮肤清单记录为 `0.1.7rc2`）：设置面板改为挂在 body 下后的样式与侧栏容器同步跟进。
- Windows 桌面版收起侧栏后，标题栏中的切换 / 新建会话按钮恢复正常。

### 皮肤管理
- 面板改用 DSH 原生控件：原生开关、按钮与设置行排版；下拉框统一为原生设置下拉样式（240px 列宽、同面板等高），长选项省略显示，不再被长描述挤压截断。
- 新增可选的「桌面图标跟随皮肤」（仅 Windows 桌面版，默认关闭）。
- 修复“不那么二次元模式”时间段选择器的时 / 分下拉被挤出。

### ORCA LINK
- 新增可选项：上滚隐藏输入框、输入框拖拽收起手柄、首页标题打字机动画（默认开启，与之前一致）。
- 手动收起输入框后的恢复按钮不再与「回到底部」重叠，并与其居中对齐。
- 以 div 绘制的卡片与面板（如右侧栏“新建终端”）也保持直角。
- 恢复 todo 的 ORCA 风格图标（待处理 / 进行中像素格 / 已完成），补齐 0.1.7 中变更或新增的时钟、用户、多用户图标。
- Windows 标题栏菜单（应用 / 编辑）改为直角，hover 与相邻控件一致；去掉对话区左上角的窗口圆角。

### 深海女仆工坊
- Windows 标题栏：修复菜单 hover 文字不可见、原生最小化 / 最大化 / 关闭按钮看不清；标题栏控件统一为 6px 圆角；去掉对话区左上角圆角。
- 新会话按钮 hover 时，快捷键提示展开让位，不再遮挡“新会话”。
- 暗色首页标题去掉描边，修复中文字形发灰、带缺口。
- 修复展开 / 收起侧栏时立绘闪烁（暗色整体变亮、亮色四周光晕闪动）。
- 工作区横幅入场动画改为连续减速，末尾不再顿挫。

### 性能
- 生成回复时，皮肤不再为对话内容的每次变化重复扫描页面（长对话中观察回调的额外开销由约 8.6 秒 / 300 批降至测不出）。
- ORCA 状态小人在动画播完、窗口在后台、小人关闭或开启减少动效时停止计时；信号点呼吸动画改为只动透明度。

详情：[PR #150](https://github.com/Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale/pull/150)

---

npm 包：两套皮肤 `0.1.6`，皮肤管理器 `0.1.5`，源码与构建产物已同步。按 README 的命令更新或重新安装即可；新版发布后约 24 小时内 `update` 可能仍停在上一版，想马上更新见 README「更新」一节。

body:
### 修改内容
*   优化：改善多标签页同时打开时的卡顿，合并跨标签页的设置读取、登录信息和未读消息请求，后台标签页等到可见时再初始化 #1212
*   优化：减少图片加载队列的重复计算，移除收藏合集中无用的头像请求
*   优化：移除动态卡片底部的「查看详情」按钮
*   修复：动态详情在新标签页打开时在 Firefox/Zen 下被关闭 @Yuuzi261 #1227
*   修复：Bewly 宽屏超宽视频被限制为 16:9，改为按视频实际比例计算宽度，并支持从边缘展开侧栏 @akinal5765-byte #1233
*   修复：退出 Bewly 宽屏后点击推荐视频切集，评论区没有更新 @Chino456 #1254
*   修复：视频页收藏弹窗中已满收藏夹的勾选与禁用表现 @KurotaniTakeo #1256
*   修复：历史记录打开视频丢失分 P 信息、历史搜索刷新异常，以及原版历史页顶栏自动隐藏失效 #1245
*   修复：合集视频误用分 P 播放设置
*   修复：播放器初始化超时、重试任务无法取消及页面生命周期处理异常
*   修复：搜索、收藏及合集缓存的异步状态互相覆盖，请求增加超时，并取消过期的搜索请求

name: NipaPlay-Reload
body:
## 新功能

**媒体库综合排序与 NEW 角标** ([#909](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/909))

媒体库新增「综合排序」并设为默认：有新内容的番剧优先显示，其余按最近观看时间自然排列。新番剧或有新集数的番剧，卡片右上角会显示红色 NEW 角标，进入番剧详情后自动消除。综合排序规则取「点开详情时间」与「NEW 首次发现时间」的较新者，新内容置顶后随时间自然下沉（优化详见 [#917](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/917)）。

**主页顶部推荐区独立开关 + 启动时自动智能刷新** ([#912](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/912))

外观设置中新增三个独立开关，可分别控制主页顶部的大图轮播、右上小卡片和右下小卡片；全部关闭时不留空白。App 启动后会自动执行一次智能刷新（延迟 2 秒，无变化时无额外开销）。

**截图与 GIF 截取弹窗** ([#915](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/915))

播放器新增统一的画面截取弹窗，分「图片截取」和「GIF 截取」两个选项卡。图片截取支持当前画面预览、选择是否合成弹幕与字幕、截图时临时关闭字幕轨并在完成后恢复；iOS 端提供「保存到相册」和「保存到文件」两个操作。GIF 截取支持设置时间范围、输出尺寸、帧率和质量，并可预览、复制到剪贴板或导出文件。GIF 导出不依赖当前播放器内核，使用 libmpv、MDK 等内核时同样可调用 Erika 导出，且不会中断当前播放。桌面端也新增了截图按钮入口。WebDAV 和 SMB 私有地址会在导出或分享前自动解析为实际播放地址。后续修复了 iOS 上「导出动图文件」无效、「保存到文件」写入不可访问目录以及 GIF 菜单文本框无法唤起输入法的问题（[#941](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/941)）。

**Erika 多平台原生 GIF 导出** ([#925](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/925))

GIF 导出能力扩展至 Android、iOS、tvOS、Windows 和 OpenHarmony，不再仅限于 macOS。即使当前使用 libmpv 等其他播放器内核，也可通过独立 Erika 工具模块执行导出。

**弹弹play 网关主/备服务器自动选择** ([#919](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/919))

新增国内备用网关，客户端根据用户出口 IP 归属地自动在香港主服务器与国内备用服务器之间切换，判定结果缓存 6 小时。同一线路连续失败 3 次后自动由备用线路临时接管 5 分钟。网络设置中新增「自动选择（推荐）/ 香港服务器 / 国内服务器 / 自定义」下拉菜单，并显示当前实际生效的线路。实测国内网络下弹幕与番剧信息加载速度大幅提升。

**外挂字幕调色盘与字幕颜色输入优化** ([#927](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/927))

字幕颜色输入改为点击弹出独立对话框，支持 HSV 三滑块（色相/饱和度/亮度）全色调色盘与 Hex 输入双向同步，解决了横屏播放器中键盘弹出后输入框被遮挡的问题。外挂字幕支持长按弹出独立设置面板，可独立设置颜色和字体，不影响内嵌字幕轨的设置。

**截图黑边裁剪、长按截图弹窗与画面比例模式** ([#928](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/928))

截图新增裁剪黑边开关，按视频实际宽高比裁去画面外的黑边区域。截图按钮支持单击直拍、长按弹出设置（格式/质量、弹幕/字幕合成、裁剪黑边等）。存储设置页新增截图质量档位（低/普通/高/超高）。播放器控制栏新增画面比例按钮，提供适应、填充、拉伸及 16:9、4:3 等共 9 种比例模式，设置持久化保存。

**实验性新版媒体信息页面** ([#934](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/934))

提供仿流媒体平台风格的沉浸式媒体信息页面，可在实验室中开启，横竖屏设备均适用。手机端竖屏时海报占页面上半部分，下方使用动态取色渐变填

name: WWPlayer
body:
「v1.2.8」

## 新功能

- 新增 Bangumi 番剧发现源与每日放送日历，支持匹配服务器资源并进入影视详情页。
- 新增“默认”“猫头”“浅色”三套应用图标，可在设置中切换。
- 播放器 OSD 字号新增 25% 至 150% 六档调节。

## 优化

- 优化播放网络稳定性，减少后台图片、发现、聚合及弹幕请求对当前播放的影响。
- 改善网络中断、缓冲停滞和异常断流后的播放恢复表现。
- 代理设置新增出口 IP 与地区信息展示。
- 优化整集缓存，按时长缓存上限提升至 1200 秒。
- 优化 Jellyfin 登录鉴权、搜索、聚合、Next Up、收藏及播放进度兼容性。
- 优化发现页启动与图片加载性能，减少大量栏目同时加载造成的卡顿。
- 优化详情页剧集与跨服务器资源加载，保持选中集数、资源和列表位置稳定。
- 搜索结果较多时增加“查看更多”入口，并根据页面宽度调整展示数量。
- 外置 mpv 剧集列表补充剧集名称、季集编号和单集标题。
- 服务器管理卡片改用图标展示电影、剧集、单集、线路和延迟信息。
- 调整浅色应用图标配色，并优化不同尺寸下的图标显示效果。
- 选集列表不再因分段而无法进入上一页或下一页。
- 轮播图数据现在使用随机池。

## 修复

- 修复 WebDAV、OpenList 等服务器进入首页后长期停留在加载状态的问题。
- 修复音轨、字幕、音量偏好未及时保存，以及切集或重新播放后无法正确恢复的问题。
- 修复影片最后数秒被提前判定播放结束、自动切集过早的问题。
- 修复部分服务器连续切集等待时间过长的问题。
- 修复继续播放记录来源混乱、进度回退、跨服务器串用及首页更新不及时的问题。
- 修复跨设备播放进度同步、标记已观看和清除播放进度不可靠的问题。

### 🚀 全新特性

- Launcher 新增「ASR 识别预设」库：可搜索、加载、更新、复制和管理带描述的预设，创建或复制后直接改名；Qwen 上下文、OpenAI Prompt 与 Soniox Text 共用同一提示词并只保存一份；操作按钮集中在弹窗底部并带悬停说明，名称/描述修改后失焦即保存；删除预设移入回收站，预设库目录可在设置中更改。

- 默认停顿切句阈值从 800ms 调整为 500ms（Launcher 切句参数与 CLI `--gap-split` 默认值同步调整）。

name: aliyunpan
body:
# BoxPlayer v5.0.34

## 重点更新：内置 MPV 成为默认播放器

桌面版默认使用内置 MPV，仍可选择内置网页播放器或自定义播放软件。支持 macOS arm64/x64、Windows x64 和 Linux x64/arm64；Windows ARM64 暂不支持，也不提供对应安装包。

内置 MPV 提供播放/暂停、进度跳转、倍速、音量、章节、播放列表、画面比例、视频内置音轨与字幕切换，以及外挂字幕加载。网盘与 Emby 播放保留来源要求的 Authorization、Cookie、User-Agent、Referer、Origin 等请求头；需鉴权的媒体与字幕使用账号感知的本地代理。

## 稳定性与测试

- 修复内置 MPV 关闭、重新打开或结束播放时可能导致 Electron 闪退的问题。
- 改进 Emby 直连播放、请求头处理与播放失败诊断。
- 修复真实播放测试中 Electron 未正常退出造成的 CI 超时。
- 在 Windows x64、Linux x64/arm64、macOS arm64/x64 验证真实网盘和 Emby 的 MPV 播放。Windows 不再运行单独的网盘搜索、上传、下载与文件操作测试。115、Box 和 189 暂不纳入真实账号播放门禁。
- 修复 Google Drive 账号切换按钮无响应、网页播放器字幕菜单重复层级，并改进夸克鉴权下载与 115/Box 刷新令牌处理。

## English

### Embedded MPV is now the default player

The desktop app now defaults to embedded MPV while retaining the built-in web player and external-player options. Supported platforms are macOS arm64/x64, Windows x64, and Linux x64/arm64. Windows ARM64 is not supported and no installer is provided.

Embedded MPV supports playback controls, seeking, speed, volume, chapters, playlists, aspect controls, audio-track and subtitle switching, and external subtitles. Cloud-drive and Emby playback preserve required authorization, cookies, User-Agent, Referer, and Origin headers; an account-aware local proxy handles authenticated media and subtitles.

### Stability and validation

- Fixed an intermittent Electron crash when closing, reopening, or finishing MPV playback.
- Improved direct Emby playback, authentication-header handling, and failure diagnostics.
- Fixed CI teardown timeouts caused by Electron processes that did not exit cleanly.
- Real cloud-drive and Emby MPV playback is validated on all supported desktop platforms. Windows no longer runs separate search, upload, download, or file-operation API tests. 115, Box, and Tianyi 189 are excluded from the real-account playback gate for now.
- Also fixes Google Drive account switching and the duplicate web-player subtitle-menu layer, with Quark authenticated-dow

name: MFGAdaUnlock-RenoDx
body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **First-launch restart required:** After installing or updating the addon, the first launch may perform DLSS-G kernel compilation and exhibit temporary stutter or uneven pacing. Let compilation finish, then fully restart the game once before evaluating performance or image quality.

## DLSS-G workload optimization

- Added conservative fast paths for saturated confidence, interior-border and candidate-agreement cases.
- Full quality calculations remain active for difficult pixels and boundary regions.
- NVIDIA driver JIT validation reduced the synthetic kernel from 19 to 18 registers per thread.
- Common identity paths can avoid up to 28 PTX operations. The real-world gain depends on the game, resolution and scene; this is not a universal FPS or latency guarantee.

## Latency measurement and guard reliability

- Fixed timing validation that could remain permanently in `Timing unverified`.
- Source timing now validates from Simulation + Present markers, while queue timing is validated independently.
- The UI now reports exact validation reasons, median/p95 queue and pipeline timing, active GPU work, DLSS-G workload, dominant observed stage and monitoring overhead.
- Automatic Latency Guard remains opt-in. It tests a lower addon-forced multiplier first, may then test a small source-rate trim, and rolls back when measured latency does not improve. `Monitor Only` remains the default.

## VRAM and resource diagnostics

- Added read-only process VRAM and DLSS-G resource diagnostics for future optimization work.
- No experimental resource-release behavior is enabled in this release.

## Compatibility and validation

- Existing Adaptive Quality behavior and difficult-region quality paths are preserved.
- Clean release build completed successfully.
- All 16 automated tests passed.
- Modified quality PTX was accepted by the NVIDIA driver JIT.

Thanks to everyone who tested the experimental builds and supplied pacing, latency and image-quality feedback.

name: OptiScaler-DLSSNR-PreSR-Multipass
body:
# v0.8.91 prerelease - compressed model input preview

Adds **Debug view → Compressed model input** and a **Preview** checkbox directly below **Peripheral compression**. Both control the same saved setting (`DebugView=4`) on DX12 and native Vulkan, including the existing DX12 bridges.

The preview displays the immutable input passed to NR before spatial unpacking, scaled to fill the screen. This makes the squeezed peripheral geometry visible. Without active compression it shows ordinary model input. Apply model must be enabled. Existing Proxy and Model output debug views retain unpacked geometry; unticking Preview turns debug view off.

Retains v0.8.9's spatial compression and compatibility behavior. Standard and optional RTX40-MFG packages are provided; preserve game-specific INI settings when updating. NVIDIA model/FG runtime DLLs are not bundled. Live game preview and RTX40 hardware validation have not been performed.

Validation: Release x64 standard and RTX40-MFG builds succeeded; the full NR prerelease suite passed. Every payload checksum in both ZIPs was verified.

keeps newer builds. If the install directory is occupied by a different build,

npm install -g codewhale

# CC Switch v3.20.4

> 这一版以修复为主，另有一项新接入：**MiniMax Code 成为第十个受管应用**，供应商、MCP、Skills、提示词、会话浏览与用量统计一并接入，默认模型、登录和会话删除仍由 MiniMax Code 自己管。修复主要集中在经本地代理使用 Codex 的场景，四个会让 Codex 用不下去的问题在本版关闭：Codex 0.154 起放进 `additional_tools` 的工具让严格的 Chat 网关直接 400；一张 `detail: "original"` 的截图让整段会话此后每轮都 400；编辑或切走部分 Codex 供应商会悄悄清空已保存的 API Key；绑定到已删除 ChatGPT 账号的卡片既切不走，也改不了绑定。Claude Code 这边，GitHub Copilot 下的 auto mode 恢复可用，`/effort` 的 `xhigh`、`max` 与 Grok 4.6 的推理强度都按所选档位发送。Claude Desktop 的第三方配置现在也支持 Linux。**本版含数据库迁移（v18 → v19），建议升级前手动备份一次数据库**，见[升级提醒](#本版含数据库迁移)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/v3.20.4/docs/release-notes/v3.20.4-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/v3.20.4/docs/release-notes/v3.20.4-ja.md)**

---

## 重点内容：你现在可以

- **用 CC Switch 管理 MiniMax Code**（[#7383](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7383)、[#7578](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7578)）：第十个受管应用。供应商写进 `~/.minimax/config.yaml`，与 MiniMax Code 自己的设置共存，多个供应商可以同时存在；MCP 与 `~/.minimax/mcp.json` 双向同步；Skills 与 `AGENTS.md` 提示词库一并接入；预设来自 Pi 的预设目录，共 41 个。默认模型、登录与会话删除**仍由 MiniMax Code 自己管**，CC Switch 不碰。
- **在看板里看到 MiniMax Code 的会话与用量**：只读浏览会话、复制 resume 命令；用量以独立的「MiniMax Code (Session)」来源增量导入，首次同步会补齐历史。
- **在 Linux 上给 Claude Desktop 切第三方供应商**（[#7331](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7331)，修复 [#4855](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/4855)）：配置路径与 macOS、Windows 一致，Flatpak 版也能用。
- **Codex 0.154 及以后版本经 Chat 网关不再 400**（[#7454](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7454)，修复 [#7451](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7451)、[#6158](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6158)）：`additional_tools` 里的工具正确并入请求，不再变成一条 `content: null` 的 system 消息。
- **一张截图不再毁掉整段 Codex 会话**（[#7476](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7476)，修复 [#6495](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6495)、[#7458](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7458)）：已经坏掉的会话升级后直接恢复，不用手动改历史。
- **编辑或切走 Codex 供应商不再清空已保存的 API Key*

name: DeskBox
body:
# DeskBox 1.5.5

DeskBox 1.5.5 is a feature-packed reliability update: cloud backup to your own WebDAV server with scoped, tombstone-safe restore; drag-and-drop that Copy-only targets finally accept; cross-volume transfers through the Windows file-operation engine; self-healing hotkeys; idle memory trimming; and a Fluent snap-feedback refresh.

Released on September 22, 2026.

## Highlights

- **Cloud backup to your own server.** Settings → Maintenance gains a WebDAV cloud-backup page: per-domain toggles (todo, quick capture, widget style), configurable interval and retention, credentials stored in Windows Credential Manager, a "Test connection" that validates what you just typed, on-demand backups, and a browsable remote snapshot list.
- **Scoped, tombstone-safe restore.** Pick which data domains come back and choose merge (newer entries win, nothing on this device is deleted) or a full snapshot-faithful restore. Deletions leave tombstones, so a merged restore can never resurrect an item you removed locally; restores stage, validate, and apply on the next launch with a pre-restore safety archive pinned.
- **Drag-and-drop that works everywhere.** File drags out of widgets carry the same native Shell data object Explorer uses, so Copy-only drop targets that used to reject DeskBox — VS Code, browsers and other Chromium/Electron apps, WM_DROPFILES-era programs, WinForms — now accept them. Same-volume drops default to move, cross-volume to copy, Ctrl/Shift/Alt behave as expected on Windows 11, and Windows 10 keeps single-move without prompting.
- **Cross-volume transfers through the system engine.** Cross-volume moves and copies now use IFileOperation with native progress, cancellation, and conflict handling — fixing the Native AOT cross-volume import that completed with "0 items". Aborted transfers clean up only the objects they created.
- **Hotkeys that heal themselves.** Windows can silently strip the low-level hooks behind the global hotkey, search hotkey, or deskto

name: CompactGUI
body:
### Changes
- **Low Disk Space Safety Check Changes**
  - Added a configuration setting to bypass low disk space warnings #669 
  - Redesigned the Compactor/Uncompactor file queue to catch low disk space issues and retry items sequentially (see below). As a result, safe free space requirements are now:
     - Compression: 2x the size of the largest file in the folder
     - Uncompression: Difference between the folder's compressed and uncompressed size, _plus_ the size of the largest file in the folder
- **Compactor Internal Rework**
  - The compactor (and uncompactor) now properly catch errors related to being low on disk space, and will then re-attempt those files in sequential mode (one file compression at a time) at the end, just in case enough space had been freed up by previous files being compressed. 
- **Hide Tabs**
  - Add option to hide Steam Library and Compression DB tabs - for those using it on work PCs. #671

### Tweaks
 - Added config option to disable hardware rendering (config-file only) #658
 - UI Tweaks (added hover effects to library view, changed "Compress x games" to "Compress x items")
 - Performance improvements in the Core library functions

### Builds
 - Finally remembered to create an `ARM64` build. Untested as I don't have an ARM device to check it on #556

-----
### Installation
#### Binaries

````yml
CompactGUI.exe (10MB):		 Smaller size, but requires .NET 10 Runtime to be installed
CompactGUI.mono.exe (66MB):	 Fully self-contained and embeds the necessary .NET 10 libraries
CompactGUI.arm64.exe (10MB): ARM64 build, also requires .NET 10 Runtime to be installed
````

#### WinGet
```ahk
winget install CompactGUI
```
>[!NOTE]
> Installing from `WinGet` automatically installs .NET 10 if required, however it can often take a few days for new releases to become available.

name: OptiScaler-DLSSNR-PreSR-Multipass
body:
Removes the unsafe Finished Picture NR cross-queue wait reviewed in PR #70. Includes all v0.8.6 shutdown fixes.

- Unfinished cross-queue input is skipped on every presentation path, preventing NR from introducing a producer/presentation fence cycle.
- Same-queue input and completed cross-queue input remain eligible; composition selects the newest compatible eligible slot.
- This corrects the remaining safety gap in the v0.8.5 rewrite carried into v0.8.6. PR #70 is now closed with the review explanation.

**Tradeoff:** Finished Picture NR may be skipped when another queue has not completed its input, including the RDR2 configuration reported in PR #70. Guaranteed per-frame NR there needs an integration with proven queue ordering. Pre-SR-only processing is unaffected by this change.

The WARP queue-readiness test, automated NR prerelease suite, and both Release x64 builds passed. Both archives and their checksums were verified. The review counterexample reproduced the old wait policy stalling, but **the reported NVIDIA shutdown hang/Event 153 has not been reproduced or confirmed resolved on the affected game/driver.** The RTX40 MFG implementation is unchanged; no RTX40 hardware validation is claimed.

Use **OptiScaler-NR-v0.8.7.zip** for the standard build, or **OptiScaler-NR-v0.8.7-rtx40-mfg.zip** for the optional RTX40 MFG build. Extract the complete package. NVIDIA model/FG runtime DLLs are not bundled.

Source: `a8eac0c4195bb5d2c93a08055c05b584d5c98953` on `codex/nr-v0.8.6-shutdown`.

[Detailed changes and validation](https://github.com/wilsjo2/OptiScaler-DLSSNR-PreSR-Multipass/blob/v0.8.7/docs/RELEASE-v0.8.7.md).

name: vorssaint-utils
body:
### Summary
This beta focuses on Dynamic Island, with a horizontal layout in place of the vertical stack and updated music, notifications, timers and controls. Dock Preview also gains an experimental option to keep an auto-hidden Dock visible while you browse previews.

### Changed
- Dynamic Island adopts a horizontal layout, with side-by-side cards, a redesigned mixer, compact calendar and timer controls, and an embedded Scratchpad.
- Dynamic Island can be shorter, down to 260 points, with content that adapts to the available space. Opening it during music, a timer, a download or a notification goes straight to that activity.
- App Switcher shows more window previews when space allows, including two side by side.

### Added
- Dynamic Island previews notification messages on hover, with actions to open, dismiss or browse the inbox.
- Dynamic Island gains a stopwatch and optional music bars that follow playback. Music bars require system audio permission.
- Dynamic Island can show compact activity over menu bar items, off by default under At rest in settings.
- Dock Preview can experimentally keep an auto-hidden Dock visible while you browse window previews. Enable it under More options; it is off by default.
- Screen recordings export video, GIFs and shared links at custom speeds from 0.25× to 4×, with pitch-preserving audio.
- The mixer adds microphone volume control on supported devices, plus pinned apps and a saved custom order.
- Command Bar adds scientific calculations and emoji skin tones.
- Keep Awake offers separate Duration and Until modes and can require all selected automation conditions to remain active.
- Clipboard History can show the latest copied content beside the menu bar icon.

### Fixed
- Dynamic Island more reliably identifies playing media, avoids flickering on displays without a camera cutout, and stays out of tiling window managers.
- Dynamic Island uses clear on/off switches for Mac sound and microphone when selecting a screen recording.

-   **[账号管理与配额安全健壮性修复] 彻底解决打开账号管理 TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'filter') 崩溃 (Fixes #3491)**:
    -   **空桶安全兜底与解构保护**: 全面排查并修复 `AccountCard`、`AccountTable`、`quotaDisplay`、`Dashboard` 以及 `AccountDetailsDialog` 中对 `group.buckets` 与 `group.display_name` 的直接访问，增加安全可选链与空数组保底降级（`group.buckets || []`），杜绝因历史旧数据或不完整配额响应导致的前端白屏崩溃。
    -   **前端类型定义契约对齐**: 将 `QuotaGroup` 中的 `buckets` 明确标注为可选字段（`buckets?: QuotaBucket[]`），强化编译期静态空安全检查。
    -   **后端 Rust 反序列化平滑兼容**: 为 Rust `QuotaGroup.buckets` 添加 `#[serde(default)]`，历史数据或旧配置中缺失 `buckets` 字段时自动初始化为空集合，提供双向平滑兼容。

name: just-the-browser
body:
This update contains changes to the **Firefox** configuration and **Google Chrome** configuration. You can [install Just the Browser](https://justthebrowser.com/) again to get the latest versions. Existing users on other browsers do not need to update, unless the settings are not working.

### Configuration settings
- Chrome's AI-powered "Help Me Read" feature is now blocked (but is currently only rolled out on ChromeOS anyway)
- Chrome is now blocked from using generative AI to fill out form fields
- Chrome will no longer "suggest AI capabilities at relevant moments"
- Chrome will no longer use AI Mode integrations from any third-party search engine set as the browser's default search
- Firefox's AI features can now be turned back on individually if desired, instead of being fully locked by the configuration
- Firefox is now blocked from showing sponsored suggestions as you type in the address bar
- Firefox's "Search Image with Google Lens" feature in the right-click context menu is now blocked, since it uses Google's AI Mode, (Chrome's equivalent menu was already disabled in the Chrome configuration)

name: oh-my-openagent
body:
### Changed

**The engine moves to senpi 2026.9.20, and two long-standing TUI annoyances go with it.**

Provider network failures now collapse into a single retry status instead of printing their whole error payload on every attempt. The status updates in place, clears itself when the provider recovers, and stops claiming a failed retry when you cancel a turn. An exhausted chain leaves one notice with a next step, and partial answers and the stored error detail survive reopening the session.

Answering an `ask_user_question` card with the mouse no longer kills the keyboard. Clicking the option rows and the Submit line handed focus to the wrapper around them, which has no key handler, so every later keystroke went nowhere while output and tools carried on as usual. Focus now resolves to a component that can receive keys, and a focus change made by a click handler is no longer overwritten afterwards.

Picking a model the conversation does not fit into yet no longer discards the choice. The switch is held, your next message compacts first, summarized by the model that can still read the whole transcript and sized for the window it is moving into, and the new model takes over from there. An automatic fallback repairs a rung the same way instead of rejecting it, and Ctrl+P passes over only a model that could never serve the session. Fable 5 also has a default fallback chain again, and it stays in the Anthropic family: Opus 5, then Opus 4.8, then Opus 4.6.

Startup and session opens got faster. The `senpi` command was still booting an unbundled module graph, which took a real TUI launch from 6.3 s to 1.2 s. The shared host stopped rebuilding the same model catalog and re-resolving the same installed packages for every session, so a single open lands about 40% sooner and eight at once about 30% sooner. name: macshot
body:
### Fixed

- **Cuts and speed edits** — use a compatible editing clock so fractional-second recording tails do not trigger “invalid time range” or leave playback on the uncut timeline.
- **Video effects preview and saving** — preserve exact recording end times so fractional-second clips do not lose effect previews or fail to save with “Operation Stopped”.
- **Mouse click highlighting permissions** — enabling click highlights now requests Input Monitoring access, just like Show Keystrokes. Entering recording setup keeps unavailable saved options off and requests access only when you enable one.
- **Move shortcut before recording** — the configured Move shortcut, including Space, now moves the selected recording area before recording starts.
- **Recordings stopped right after starting produced nothing** — stopping within the first moments left the capture stream running with nothing able to stop it, kept the microphone active, and ended the session silently. Recording failures are now reported instead of disappearing with the HUD.
- **Screenshots that couldn't be saved vanished without a word** — a full disk or an unmounted save folder now shows an error instead of dismissing the overlay as if the capture had been written. The same applies to a capture that can't be stored in history.
- **Annotations lost from older captures** — captures saved by earlier versions failed to load their annotations, and a single damaged entry discarded every annotation in that capture. Beautify settings and the capture list itself had the same flaw.
- **Over-saturated screenshots with crushed greys** — the Vivid effect could stay silently enabled from a much older version, tinting every capture. That state is now cleared once on launch. (#345)
- **Invert Colors with a window-snapped selection** — inverted the screen behind the capture instead of the capture itself, and image effects were dropped entirely when beautify's window snap was on. (#88)

body:
> [!CAUTION]
> **Review file categories after upgrading.** Category rules now require an explicit relative or absolute directory mode. Rules from earlier versions are not migrated; reconfigure custom rules in Settings → Downloads. Classification now chooses the destination before downloading; completed files are no longer moved automatically.
>
> **Check custom proxy bypass rules.** Use hostnames, domains, IP addresses, CIDR networks or `*`. Replace unsupported patterns such as `*.local`, `127.*` and `<local>` with supported entries before starting the engine.

## What's Changed

This beta combines the two left navigation columns into one persistent sidebar and fixes download destination handling, browser activation and Windows installation cleanup.

### 🛠 Improvements

- Merge task filters, About and Settings into one sidebar. Narrow windows retain an animated compact icon rail with task counts and tooltips.
- Move settings sections into horizontal tabs and keep Save, Discard, engine restart and transfer speed in one footer. Adapt task controls to available width while keeping window controls on a separate top row.
- Use one native classification policy for browser downloads, manual tasks and torrent selection. Relative categories follow the current download directory; absolute categories keep a fixed destination. Explicit task destinations take precedence, and mixed file sets keep their base directory. ([#622](https://github.com/AnInsomniacy/rayburst/issues/622))
- Remove unnecessary sorting from history snapshots and use indexed ordering for database pages, reducing temporary sorting work when reading large histories. ([#597](https://github.com/AnInsomniacy/rayburst/issues/597))

name: clash-party
body:
# 2.0.3

## 新功能

- 新增订阅 DNS 覆写保护，避免意外覆盖自定义解析配置
- Smart 内核新增模型状态、手动下载及自动更新设置
- 支持按 WiFi SSID 自动切换订阅，macOS 使用事件驱动检测
- 新增自定义 GitHub 下载代理和覆写全局开关快捷入口
- 机场插件支持多网关、备用发现源、签名发现文档、网关说明及网络请求自动回退

## 性能优化

- 优化应用启动流程，首屏完成后再执行其余初始化
- 合并连接列表高频更新，页面不可见时暂停处理
- 修复连接页面、IPC 监听器及 Monaco 编辑器相关资源泄漏

## 修复

- 修复恶意 `rule-providers` 配置可能执行任意命令的安全问题
- 修复内核下载校验、解压失败及 macOS 路径含空格时的权限问题
- 修复 Smart 组生成、设置热重载及模型重复下载问题
- 修复 PAC、Gist、悬浮窗、覆写拖拽与并发读写等稳定性问题
- 修复规则编辑器、WebDAV、流量表格及配置读写问题
- 修复系统唤醒后内核、TUN 或系统代理失效，以及内核启动失败提示异常的问题
- 修复 macOS 开机自启、内核残留、托盘状态及安装包公证票据问题
- 修复 Windows WiFi 权限频繁请求、ARM64 安装包及 Windows 8/8.1 系统代理兼容问题
- 修复代理组搜索中文输入中断、TUN 重复重建及代理列表高度异常问题
- 修复订阅流量大数值解析、Sub-Store 回退路径及 Emoji 字体下载问题
- 提升机场插件的订阅校验、自动更新、设备回收、凭据保护、超时和并发安全性

## 其他

- 重写流量统计存储并自动迁移历史数据
- CI 新增格式、lint、类型检查及单元测试
- 更新机场服务端对接指南，并移除 `https-proxy-agent` 依赖

## 如何使用

2. 双击对应的 `MAW` 可执行文件，打开启动器
3. 在启动器中，可以执行字幕转写、生成工程等操作
4. 完成后，启动字幕编辑器，进行字幕精修

详细文档参阅：[完整使用文档](https://github.com/Moyf/moys-asr-workflow/blob/main/docs/WORKFLOW.md)
遇到问题可以参见：[常见问题](https://github.com/Moyf/moys-asr-workflow/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md)

## [1.6.0-beta.6] - 2026-09-20

### ✨ 提升

- **ASS 说话人名称颜色**：新增仅为 `XX：` 说话人前缀应用颜色的 ASS 预览与导出模式，正文继续使用当前 ASS 样式的主色。
- **拆分面板**：新增「拆分并保留原文」，可在不切分字幕文本的情况下把一条字幕按当前断点拆成两条，并让两边保留相同文本。
- **说话人预览与导出联动**：颜色映射开启时默认显示预览中的说话人名称，并自动勾选导出名称；ASS 颜色字幕选择「作为说话人名称颜色」时提供跳转导出设置的提示。

### 🔄 变更

- **输出目录与后处理产物默认值**：Launcher 默认将所有输出文件放入媒体旁的 `_maw` 子文件夹，并默认保留自动后处理的中间产物；运行目录额外保存编号为 0 的原始快照，后续 `.mosp` / `.srt` 阶段按序号和阶段名命名；两项仍可在设置中关闭。

### 🐛 修复

- **文稿匹配** ： 保留录音中明显属于文稿之外的 ASR 字幕段；重新分段时不会再把中间多录的句子吞入后一个文稿句。

- **双语字幕中缝位置** ： 修复中缝联动区错误落在副字幕 lane、导致主字幕中缝无法正常命中的问题。

### 🐛 修复

- **文稿匹配的闭合符号**：修复问号等断句符号后的 `」`、`”`、`》` 等常见闭合标点在部分工程中被误删的问题。
- **播放点击暂停**：全局设置新增「播放过程中点击鼠标自动暂停」，开启后播放中通过鼠标点击字幕、波形或空隙跳转会在定位后暂停，默认关闭。

name: Flow.Launcher
body:
# Release notes

## Bug fixes

- Fixed Firefox bookmark loading when profiles.ini uses different line endings.

- Reduced error log noise by treating missing shortcut descriptions as debug messages instead of errors.

- History results now appear on startup when the “Show History Results in Home Page” option is enabled, even if the home page is turned off.

- Context menus on the home page now open with the right arrow and show up-to-date options.

- Flow will now take keyboard focus on Windows startup (when not hidden), so you can type in the search box right away.

- Fixed an issue that could leave outdated data in settings or other stored files when saving a new version with shorter JSON content.

- Improved shell command handling for quoted paths and multi-word arguments. Command history now properly preserves your original input.

- Quoted commands now run correctly in the Windows CMD shell, and command launching via Windows Terminal is more reliable.

- Improved URL support for browser, file, about:, and data: links. Removed insecure ftp:// support.

- Improved URL matching for local and private IP addresses, including IPv6 support.

- Updated translations

- More reliable full screen detection on Windows with reduced chance of crashes.

- Fixed a bug that could set the app to the wrong language on startup.

- Search via acronyms has been fixed to properly work with results that contain numbers.

## Contributions
We would like to directly mention and thank the following people (in alphabetical order) for their contribution and support in this release.

@DavidGBrett, @dedonnodev, @Jack251970, @SparkUiX, @taooceros, @VictoriousRaptor and everyone who has joined discussions, added translations, created plugins, reviewed pull requests, put through their ideas or reported bugs.

A big thank you to @JakobOstgren for sponsoring us! ❤️

name: Mole
body:
Mole

Deep clean and optimize your Mac.

### Changelog 1. **Clean leaves Homebrew downloads that are still transferring alone**: a running `brew fetch` used to lose its in-flight cask downloads and its own lock files, and Homebrew's lock directory is no longer swept at all. 2. **A slow check no longer cancels the rest of the run**: a Spotlight probe, a Large files sizing pass, or a simulator runtime review that times out now skips that item and carries on, and routine timeout notes stay out of the summary. 3. **Clean reaches Notion's workspace cache**: only the cache storage is swept, the script cache and databases are left alone, and the whole family is skipped while Notion is running. 4. **Uninstall names what it could not verify**: an incomplete scan, a failed cask lookup, and undetermined ownership each arrive with the check to run, and selector rows stay on one line in an 80-column terminal. 5. **`mo` works when it is invoked through a symlink**: the launcher resolves the real directory behind the link, so it still finds its own libraries. ### 更新日志 1. **Clean 不再删除正在下载的 Homebrew 文件**：之前正在跑的 `brew fetch` 会丢掉在途的 cask 下载和它自己持有的锁，Homebrew 的锁目录现在完全不再清理。 2. **某一步检查超时不再中断整轮清理**：Spotlight 探测、大文件体积统计和模拟器运行时检查超时后只跳过这一项继续往下走，常规超时说明也不再进入结果汇总。 3. **Clean 支持 Notion 工作区缓存**：只清缓存存储，保留脚本缓存和数据库，Notion 运行期间整体跳过。 4. **Uninstall 会说明哪些没能确认**：预检没扫完、cask 查询失败、归属无法判定，都会连同该跑的检查命令一起给出，选择列表在 80 列终端里也不再折行。 5. **通过软链调用 `mo` 时能正常工作**：启动器会解析出软链背后的真实目录，因此仍能找到自己的依赖库。 ### Thanks Issue reporters and PR contributors this cycle: @ishaanko · @xtnntn · @huangy7 · @idhyt · @jiji262 · @iammike2 · @TarGz · @TyceHerrman. ### Mole Mac App Prefer a GUI? name: Auto_Bangumi
body:
# [3.3] — Stable

3.3 is the largest AutoBangumi release in a while: a fully async backend architecture, aria2 promoted to a first-class download backend, movie/OVA/special support, per-bangumi release preferences, a hardened security stack, and a WebUI that updates over SSE instead of polling. REST API behavior is backward-compatible; existing databases upgrade automatically through schema v24.

## 3.3.6 — RSS matching, proxy, parser, and deployment fixes

3.3.6 is a bugfix release for issues reported after 3.3.5.

- **RSS matching (#1103, #1114):** the parser rebuilds `title_raw` by removing the episode from the middle of the name or joining ` / `-separated aliases, so it is not always a substring of the torrent name. New episodes then failed to match and landed in Orphan Torrents. A torrent now also matches when its own rebuilt title equals the stored `title_raw`; existing rows work without a migration.
- **Subscriptions (#1105):** when a search RSS feed returns several seasons, subscribing or collecting no longer downloads the other seasons' torrents under this bangumi (where they overwrote each other during rename). Items are filtered by season and type with the same rule the RSS refresh uses.
- **HTTP proxy (#1104):** httpcore leaks the tunnel connection when CONNECT succeeds but the TLS handshake fails, so the shared pool filled up and every request hit `PoolTimeout` until restart. A `PoolTimeout` now switches later requests to a fresh client without interrupting in-flight ones.
- **Parser (#1108):** Unicode Roman numerals (`Ⅱ`, …) are read as the season, and fullwidth dashes wrapping the Chinese title are removed, so `Clevatess Ⅱ－魔獸之王與虛假的勇者傳承－` parses as season 2 and matches TMDB.
- **Docker health check (#1106):** reads the configured WebUI port and probes IPv4 then IPv6 loopback, instead of `localhost:7892`, which busybox resolved to `::1`.

IINA 1.5.0 Beta 2 fixed many critical issues in Beta 1. We will have a stable release soon.

## New

- Added support for `tone-mapping-param` #6338.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed duration text field not using monospaced digit font in main window #6322.
- Fixed adjusting bold/italic doesn't work, and font space/blur not updated continously #6326.
- Fixed the settings sidebar cannot scroll to bottom on macOS 11 #6320.
- Fixed wrong legacy full screen housing adjustment #6325.
- Fixed edit/delete buttons in key mapping disappear after scrolling #6329.
- Fixed plugin links cannot be opened #6329.
- Fixed "Default" and "None" in the sidebar not localized #6340.
- Fixed unwanted scroll actions on sliders #6324.
- Fixed artist and album info sometimes not being updated for Now Playing #6364.
- Fixed window size broken after returning from full screen #6361.
- Fixed misaligned filename text field on the titlebar for macOS 15 and below.
- Fixed dragging multiple media onto initial window always opening them in one player window #6281.
- Fixed legacy full screen camera housing issues #6201.
- Fixed ICC profile not properly applied #6334.

## Improvements

- Disable ytdl section when the online media plugin is enabled.
- Now the width of the sidebar in the settings window is fixed #6299.
- The settings window is now not movable by background #6323.
- Don't allow removing black bars in full screen #6280.
- Don't show permission alert when the plugin requires no permission.

## Plugin API

- Fixed a crash when trying to open a URL #6230.
- Fixed various permission issues #6372.
- Use main branch to check for updates.

### Deprecation Notice

IINA 1.5.0 now requires macOS 11 Big Sur or later for Intel Macs and macOS 12 Monterey or later for Apple Silicon Macs. Due to limitations of Xcode, we expect to deprecate macOS 11 in the following IINA release.

name: superpowers
body:
v6.4.0 was never shipped. v6.4.1 is the first release with these changes. It holds back the new `proving-it-works-with-a-movie` skill, which is getting cleanup and robustness work and will return in a later release.

The new `diagnosing-superpowers` skill figures out what went wrong in a session. `executing-plans` is rebuilt as Native execution, a cheaper alternative to subagent-driven development. This release also adds support for three new harnesses: OpenCode 2.0, Muse, and Qwen Code.

### New Skills

- **`diagnosing-superpowers`**: when a session goes wrong (repeated work, an ignored plan, a skill that didn't fire, a surprising bill), ask your agent to "figure out what went wrong with superpowers in this session." It pins down the problem with you, reads the transcripts on disk, and reports what happened with `path:line` evidence for every finding. On request it builds a scrubbed bundle or drafts a GitHub issue for your approval, with the cited evidence left intact. Works on the current session or a past one. (#2236, #2287)

### Executing Plans

**Heads up:** `executing-plans` no longer stops every few tasks to check in with you. It runs the whole plan, then gets one review at the end.

- **Native (inline) execution is now a real mode.** `executing-plans` was a 64-line stub that measured the same as running with no plugin at all. It is rebuilt: the session implements every task itself under the same workspace, ledger, and stopping rules as subagent-driven development, then dispatches one fresh whole-branch review on the most capable model. `task-start` and `task-done` helpers keep the ledger and test log honest. It is the cheapest way to run a plan and runs well on a mid-tier session model. (#2318)
- **The plan handoff offers two approaches, Subagent-driven and Native,** says what each costs, and recommends one for this plan with a reason drawn from the plan. If you already chose one, it keeps your choice. (#2258, #2318)

body:
# v2.2.0

DSH Vision Router 2.2.0 is the Vision Quality Round 2 release. It turns the Round 2 production fixes, Host/session compatibility work, and isolated quality harness into the new minor-release baseline.

## Highlights

- Adaptive local Tesseract evidence with canonical temp staging, bounded alternate layout attempts, confidence/uncertainty reporting, and no heuristic forced backend switch on low confidence alone.
- Source/turn-scoped degraded-evidence convergence after all configured visual backends fail, while preserving unrelated Host tools, other images, and the next Host turn.
- Stable content-addressed materialization handoff paths, eliminating the random UUID path-copy failure chain seen in real Agent traces.
- DSH-native post-execute success guidance that stops redundant visual work without changing canonical tool results or exact-character verification semantics.
- A strict single-attachment `attachmentIds` compatibility alias for `vision_ocr`, without turning OCR into a multi-image or filesystem-expanding interface.
- Session/attachment compatibility convergence across image-offload projections and evolving Host Session surfaces, with bounded asynchronous history reads instead of eager indexing.
- Catalog/tool authority fixes that preserve official DeepSeek identity through transient directory failures and restrict only tools actually registered by Vision Router.
- An isolated Round 2 Host API runner plus suite revision 2, with fresh runtime/workspace/session isolation and publish-surface self-scrubbing.

## Compatibility

- Node 22 and Node 24 remain supported.
- Windows, macOS, and Linux remain gated.
- The public minimum DSH Host remains `0.1.0-rc.8`; current preview coverage includes `0.1.6-alpha.1`.
- Existing 2.1.x settings require no migration.

name: Folo
body:
# What's New in v0.5.10

## Shiny new things

- New Reading settings to pick the article font, line height and text color, reachable from Settings > Appearance and from the article "more" menu
- Theme can now be set to System, Light or Dark manually in Settings > Appearance
- Optional immersive reading mode that hides the header while scrolling down and brings it back when scrolling up
- Added an incremental sync engine: subscriptions, unread counts, collections, lists, inboxes and timelines now follow the server's change log instead of refetching full snapshots
- Added a persisted transaction queue: read, unread, mark-all and star actions apply instantly, are sent in order, and are retried while offline
- Added a notice when the API cannot be reached

## Improvements

- Reduced launch requests: the session, action rules, settings, wallet and push token are no longer requested on every start
- Upgraded the audio player engine to avoid background service crashes
- Added Terms of Service and Privacy Policy links to the subscription plan screen

## No longer broken

- Fixed being signed out and sent to the login screen when the API was temporarily unreachable; only a real 401 clears the session
- Fixed the player and search screen layouts
- Fixed cover images missing from the entry body not being shown above the content

name: RTX40MFG-Unlock
body:
Restores the missing menu in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. The fix covers unaligned DXGI imports and games that obtain their rendering factory through a GPU adapter. The MSFS menu fix was confirmed in-game with the tested candidate.

Includes Hotfix 1's GTA V Enhanced menu/HDR/status fixes, renderer discovery, small-stack startup repair and one log/status file per installation. Dying Light 2 and Subnautica 2 in-game retests remain pending.

To update, close the game and replace the installed mod DLL, keeping its filename and settings. The ZIP contains only `RTXMFG.dll`. Press **Backspace** to open the menu.

The rebuilt release passed **44 regression cases (1,796 assertions)** and **25 font/publication checks**. These are local checks, not proof of generated-frame output in every game. RTX 30 support remains very early and experimental; Vulkan is experimental and has no Dynamic MFG.

DLL version: **1.3.3.2**. Checksums are attached.

name: FluentCleaner
body:
## FluentCleaner update - less clutter, sharper behavior
The last days were not about piling on features at any cost. I experimented with a built-in Mini mode for FluentCleaner Classic in v1.17, but ultimately pulled it before release to keep Classic small, predictable, and easy to maintain. The idea is not dead, though, it may return later as an external add-on or plugin if I decide to make FluentCleaner more extensible

**Instead, FluentCleaner Classic (only) gained something that fits its lightweight nature much better: proper command-line automation. It can now analyze or clean the saved selection silently, target individual cleaner categories, and slot neatly into batch files, PowerShell scripts, or other automation workflows.**

So Mini is out for now, but Classic has become considerably more scriptable without becoming more complicated. Less interface bolted on, more power underneath.

- **[Added] [Classic] Introduced command-line automation for scripts, batch files, PowerShell, and third-party tools. Classic can now analyze or clean the saved selection silently, optionally target a specific cleaner category, and shut down the PC after cleaning** https://github.com/builtbybel/FluentCleaner/issues/52
- [Added] [Classic] Added command-line documentation and ready-to-copy examples under Options > Handoff / CLI
- [Changed] [Classic] Development of the built-in Mini mode has been paused for now. It may return later as a separate add-on or as part of a future plugin system.
- **[Improved] [Classic] Deleting a cookie no longer throws the user back to the beginning of the list. FluentCleaner still refreshes the real browser databases, but now keeps the working position and selects the nearest remaining entry** #185
- [Added] [Classic] Added Select all to the context menus of both Cookie Manager lists. Active search filters are respected, so only currently visible cookies are selected #185
- **[Fixed] [Classic, Modern] FluentCleaner now correctly remembers

## 当前测试版本

- 插件版本：1.0.17.1
- 源码提交：5176b552e2887e233a4388dad642fd26efa93c58
- Emby 包 SHA-256：61627E9ADC0EFB80CDE2689F06CF07AC1860A92ACD81960DB43E82CA1F96BD14
- Jellyfin 包 SHA-256：A479E2844086BE63CF6785C9EFCC227910F562FB40F9DD3D25502321A6FE130C

## 变更范围

- Thunder 下载的 SRT、ASS、SSA 字幕通过内容校验后统一转换为 UTF-8，再交给 Emby 或 Jellyfin。
- 增加 GB18030、UTF-8、带或不带 BOM 的 UTF-16 字幕处理与回归测试。
- 本版本用于验证上述处理能否解决部分 Thunder 字幕在预览页面显示乱码的问题，尚需真实宿主反馈确认。
- Assrt 本轮没有功能变化。

## 测试重点

1. 使用此前预览乱码的 Thunder 字幕重新测试。
2. 检查预览页面中的中文是否正常。
3. 下载字幕后检查实际播放是否正常。
4. 确认插件页面显示的版本为 `1.0.17.1`。

## 手动安装

### Emby

1. 停止 Emby。
2. 解压 `Emby_preview.zip`。
3. 只替换 `Emby.MeiamSub.Thunder.dll`，并确认插件目录中没有重复版本。
4. 启动 Emby 后进行测试。

### Jellyfin

1. 停止 Jellyfin。
2. 解压 `Jellyfin_preview.zip`。
3. 只安装完整的 `Jellyfin.MeiamSub.Thunder_1.0.17.1` 目录，并移除旧 Thunder 版本目录。
4. 启动 Jellyfin 后进行测试。

## 反馈内容

请提供 Emby 或 Jellyfin 的完整版本、插件版本、字幕格式、预览结果和下载播放结果。该测试版不会通过稳定插件仓库自动更新。

body:
# Zen Stable Release


## Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-90/

## New Features
- Updated to Firefox 156.0
- Zen on macOS can now be set to open automatically when the computer starts up, from the Startup section of Settings.
- Added the following actions to the command bar: 'Expand current view', 'New space', 'Reopen closed tab', 'Duplicate tab', 'Reset pinned tab'.

## Fixes
- Fixed high-sample-rate FLAC audio in MP4 failing to play on certain video sites.

name: BS2PRO-Controller
body:
v3.7.0 正式版已发布。本次更新带来「冷却收益测量」，按固件实际行为重做了灯效与设备通信，并修复了蓝牙唤醒后连不上、散热器偶发重启等问题。  
v3.7.0 is now available as a stable release. It introduces cooling benefit measurement, rebuilds the lighting and device communication against the firmware's actual behavior, and fixes Bluetooth wake-up failures and sporadic cooler restarts.

## 更新亮点 / Highlights

- 新增「冷却收益测量」：在同一负载下逐档锁定转速，等温度真正不再漂移后才采样，量化每一档转速究竟换来了多少温度下降或多少额外功耗释放。结果逐传感器列出，并区分「温度墙受限」与「功耗墙受限」两种收益形态。  
- New cooling benefit measurement: under one steady load it locks each fan speed in turn and samples only after temperatures have genuinely settled, quantifying what each speed actually buys — degrees of cooling or extra sustained power. Results are listed per sensor and split into thermal-limited and power-limited cases.

- 测量报告可导出为纯文本，包含逐传感器 × 逐档位的完整读数矩阵、噪音档案与术语说明，便于交给 AI 模型自行解读。  
- The measurement report can be exported as a self-contained plain-text file with the full per-sensor by per-speed reading matrix, the noise profile and the terminology, ready to hand to an AI model for its own analysis.

- 转速上限从 4500 RPM 放宽到 5000 RPM。  
- The maximum fan speed has been raised from 4500 RPM to 5000 RPM.

- 托盘悬浮提示与右键菜单新增 CPU/GPU 功耗。读取不到功耗时整行隐藏，而不是显示一个会被当成真实读数的 0 W。  
- The tray tooltip and context menu now show CPU/GPU power. When power cannot be read the row is hidden rather than showing a 0 W value that could be mistaken for a real reading.

- 设备页读取并展示固件版本、六字节设备标识、初始化状态与运行档位等完整状态，并能区分「读取失败」与「设备不支持」。  
- The device page now reads and shows the firmware version, the six-byte device identifier, the initialization state and the running gear, and it distinguishes a failed read from an unsupported device.

- 新增固件维护命令（初始化、清除初始化标记、恢复出厂设置）。执行后 App 立即重放自己的配置，用户不会看到中间的固件默认值。  
- Firmware maintenance commands are now available (initialize, clear the initialization latch, factory reinitialize). The app replays its own configuration immediately afterwards, so the intermediate firmware defaults are never visible.

- 智能温控灯效的温度分区开放给用户设置；灯带预览按固件真实数据重写

# BoxPlayer v5.0.30

## 变更摘要

- 优化书籍阅读器与 PDF 阅读器的 BoxPlayer AI 对话体验：统一对话视觉、排版与输入提示；PDF 侧栏支持鼠标拖拽调整宽度，PDF 工具栏的 AI 按钮改为直接打开对话框。
- 新增“AI 刮削”设置。启用后，常规刮削完成才会把未匹配媒体交给 AI 处理；移除独立的 AI 刮削菜单，流程与 iOS 保持一致。
- 修复内置 AI 上游模型或流式桥接失败被误提示为“本月内置 AI 额度已用完”的问题。
- 改善文档 AI 的失败反馈和本地索引模块恢复提示。
- 修复天翼云盘会话失效后的自动刷新与重试，避免 `InvalidSessionKey` 直接中断文件下载请求。
- 移除不适用于当前能力范围的文件与目录菜单项。

## English

- Refined the BoxPlayer AI chat experience in the book and PDF readers with unified visual treatment, typography, and composer guidance. The PDF sidebar is mouse-resizable, and its AI toolbar button now opens chat directly.
- Added an **AI scraping** setting. When enabled, unmatched media is handed to AI only after normal scraping finishes; the separate AI scraping menu has been removed to match iOS.
- Fixed upstream-model and streaming-bridge failures being incorrectly reported as the monthly built-in AI quota being exhausted.
- Improved document-AI error feedback and local indexing recovery guidance.
- Fixed Tianyi Cloud session refresh and retry handling for `InvalidSessionKey` responses.
- Removed file and directory menu items outside the currently supported capability set.

name: MFGAdaUnlock-RenoDx
body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Restart the game once after installing or updating the addon.**
>
> The first launch may perform DLSS-G kernel compilation and temporarily exhibit stutter or uneven frame pacing. Do not evaluate performance or image quality until the game has been restarted once.

## Boundary Artifact Mitigation

Version 1.0 adds a unified mitigation system for artifacts around moving silhouettes and depth boundaries:

- **Balanced (Recommended)** is the default for fresh configurations. It conditions additional intermediate motion retention on local same-depth, motion-coherent support.
- **Aggressive** requires stronger neighborhood support and stays closer to NVIDIA's native rejection behavior around uncertain boundaries. It is intended for per-game testing.
- **Off** restores the version 0.9 Intermediate Scatter Retention behavior.

The system targets foreground/background bleeding, silhouette or edge stretching, motion-boundary artifacts, and depth-discontinuity artifacts. It does not change Streamline tags, the selected multiplier, Reflex, Dynamic MFG, or presentation scheduling. Existing saved choices are preserved, and changing the mode requires a full game restart.

Boundary Artifact Mitigation and **Validated Warp Blend** operate at different kernel stages and can remain enabled together.

## Redesigned ReShade interface

- Reorganized the panel into clearer status, setup, multiplier, image-quality, diagnostics, and advanced sections without removing existing controls.
- Made Dynamic MFG requirements and unavailable states explicit, including the exact DLSS-G 310.9.1 + Streamline 2.14.1 requirement.
- Clarified VSync capability reporting: driver-level VSync cannot be inferred until Streamline exposes runtime state.
- Clarified that **Native** is the normal input-quality mode and that **Automatic Guard + UI Composition** is intended for affected HDR/HUD-less integrations such as Hogwarts Legacy.
- Reworded restart-required controls so they describe pending

name: UniGetUI
body:
# Devolutions UniGetUI 2026.3.0

This feature release adds scheduled maintenance, selective automatic updates, full portable support, expanded shortcut management, and major reliability improvements across package managers and remote operations.

### New Features
* Added scheduled maintenance for update checks, automatic update installation, local backups, and cloud backups, with independent schedules, retries and timeouts.
* Added support for marking individual packages for automatic updates instead of automatically updating every package.
* Added Start Menu shortcut and folder management to the unified Manage shortcuts window, including removal, reset, relocation, post-install prompts, and command-line support.
* Added an optional Installer host column that shows each download domain and provides the full installer URL in a tooltip.
* Added configurable retention limits for timestamped local backups, with automatic removal of the oldest files.
* Added the %NAME% placeholder and a per-package subfolder style setting for creating sanitized custom installation directories.
* Added Update and Update as administrator actions to the Installed Packages page when a newer package version is available.
* Added a responsive package toolbar that moves actions into an overflow menu when the window is too narrow to display them all.
* Added warnings when an installed package version cannot be reliably verified, with explanatory tooltips in package lists and details.

### Improvements

* Improved package icon loading with bounded preloading and automatic retries after temporary failures.
* Improved update error messages for unavailable installers, already-current packages, and WinGet hash mismatches, including more relevant recovery guidance.
* Improved Linux compatibility by targeting a glibc 2.27 baseline so releases run on considerably older distributions.

## Bug fixes and Improvements
- Implemented `DXGI_SCALING_NONE` and [SetBackgroundColor](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/dxgi1_2/nf-dxgi1_2-idxgiswapchain1-setbackgroundcolor) methods for DXGI swap chains. This reportedly fixes some Adobe software. (PR #5871)
- Fixed shader compiler crash with certain ENB shaders. (PR https://github.com/doitsujin/dxbc-spirv/pull/94)

name: NipaPlay-Reload
body:
## NipaPlay v1.11.7 更新日志

### 新功能

**播放器支持跳过片头/片尾** ([#903](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/903))

播放番剧时，播放器现在可以自动识别片头和片尾区间，并在屏幕右下角显示跳过按钮。数据来源包括 AniSkip 社区标注与弹幕报点推导两种方式，两者均失败时静默降级，不影响正常播放。可在播放器设置中开启或关闭此功能。画中画模式和 UI 锁定状态下跳过按钮会自动隐藏。

---

### Bug 修复

**修复弹弹play接口因 Dart 3.13 VM 回归导致的全面崩溃，以及观看历史无法加载的问题** ([#899](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/899))

Dart 3.13 的虚拟机存在一处回归缺陷，导致登录状态下弹幕加载、排行榜、播放历史、收藏、番剧详情等接口全部失败。此外，在新旧版本之间切换后，观看历史数据库可能因迁移逻辑不幂等而永久无法打开（数据仍在，但读取失败），并伴随大量错误日志和 CPU 占用异常。本次修复同时解决了上述两个问题，已验证 173 条历史记录无丢失。关联：[#898](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/898)

**修复多端同步导致的媒体库连接丢失，并补齐同步配置的全量备份** ([#900](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/900))

多端同步功能在特定情况下会导致媒体库连接丢失。同时，多端同步的配置此前未被全量备份系统收集，现已补齐。

**修复 macOS 上绕过系统代理导致的网络请求失败** ([#904](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/904))

macOS 已启用系统代理时，NipaPlay 的网络请求此前仍会走直连，导致在校园网或企业网络环境下弹幕匹配、播放历史等接口失败。现已正确读取并应用系统代理配置，包括代理例外列表。

**修复 Android TV 上空媒体库显示异常、遥控器按键错乱及二维码输入显示不全** ([#905](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/905))

没有可用媒体来源时，媒体库现在仍会显示标题、连接提示和添加入口，遥控器可直接确认添加媒体。同时修复了遥控器菜单键和返回键的映射异常，以及二维码输入弹窗在 TV 屏幕上显示不完整的问题。关联：[#902](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/902)

**修复 Jellyfin 12 登录失败及媒体鉴权问题** ([#906](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/906))

Jellyfin 12 默认禁用了旧版鉴权方式，导致登录返回 400 错误，登录后的媒体浏览、播放进度上报及字幕请求也一并失败。现已统一适配标准鉴权协议，Emby 保持原有协议不受影响。关联：[#901](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/901)

**DFM+ 弹幕引擎优化，修复开头卡顿与弹幕抽帧问题** ([#907](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/907))

将字形预热提前到视频载入阶段，解决了弹幕在视频开头出现卡顿的问题。同时修复了进度保存占用主线程导致弹幕动画出现抽帧的问题，并优化了视频载入阶段的提示文案和插件设置页的更新提示。

---

### 内部架构

**引入统一媒体数据库架构** ([#869](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/869))

引入了新的统一媒体数据库设计（DatabaseService 与 AnimeInfoService），现阶段仅建立基础架构，不影响现有功能。后续将逐步接入业务代码，并在设置中提供实验性开关供用户选择启用。关联：[#867](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/867)

---

name: shairport-sync
body:
This update improves compatibility with Version 27 of Apple software, e.g. macOS 27, iOS 27, etc. and is recommended for all users.

The update improves the handling of unrecognised blocks of data arriving in the buffered audio stream, a phenomenon that seems to be new in OS 27.

In particular, if the first block is unrecognised, play may not begin until it is paused and resumed. This is fixed in this update.

name: Magpie
body:
# Magpie Experimental v0.6.8

## 更新内容

### DLSSNR：Multi Pass

- 新增 `Multi Pass` 下拉框，可选 **1／2／3 次**，默认 **1 次**，位于“NR 界面修正”下方。
- 每一层可独立调整 NR 风格、NR 强度、局部色调强度、局部结构强度、皮肤结构强度、自动遮罩和界面修正。选择 2／3 次后会显示对应参数列。

### DLSSNR：抗闪烁

在第二列 `Multi Pass` 下方新增“抗闪烁”，默认 **无**，支持以下互斥选项：

| 选项 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| 无 | 关闭额外的抗闪烁处理，保持原有 NR 输出 |
| 静态累积 | 平滑静止区域的修正，画面变化时采用当前结果 |
| 光流累积 | 使用光流对齐历史，平滑运动画面中的修正 |
| 光流累积+ | 在光流累积基础上，进一步缓和修正反复出现、消失造成的闪烁 |
| 低频时域重建 | 主要稳定低频修正，并重建到原输出分辨率，保留当前帧高频细节 |

单次处理时稳定本次 NR 的修正；多次处理时主要稳定后续层新增的修正。后三种路线复用光流设置。

抗闪烁会些微增加处理开销，可能带来拖影或细节响应延迟。

### Frame Generation

- **统一 XeSS 效果器**：原来的 x2 与 MFG 合并为一个 `XeSS_FrameGeneration`。新建时默认 **2×、AMD 光流、质量**。升级后，旧 XeSS 效果自动转换为统一效果器，倍率设为 2×，保留此前的光流方法与质量选择；已经使用统一效果器的配置保留所选倍率。
- **XeSS 多帧生成**：倍率可选 **2×／3×／4×**；需要时自动启用多帧兼容模式，无需额外勾选。
- **可选重复帧过滤**：DLSS FG 与 XeSS FG 的“帧数倍率”和“光流方法”之间新增复选框，默认勾选。勾选时过滤像素完全相同的捕获帧；取消后关闭这项检测，优先于全局重复帧检测设置。选项随效果组保存，运行中修改需重启缩放生效。

### 界面与修正

- 配置文件中的“参数调整焦点切换”从“常规”移到“高级”，已有选择保持不变。

## 使用说明

### 从 0.6.7 升级，或首次安装

1. 备份需要保留的设置与截图，并从托盘完全退出 Magpie。
2. 将 `Magpie-Experimental-x64.zip` **完整解压到新目录**，再运行其中的 `Magpie.exe`。不要在压缩包内运行，也不要仅替换 EXE。
3. 普通安装继续使用 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Magpie\config\v4e\config.json`。便携用户可将原设置复制到新程序目录内的 `config\v4e\config.json`，并保留备份以便回退。

## 附件的作用与使用

| 附件 | 用途与使用方法 |
| --- | --- |

name: DeepSeek-Reasonix
body:
本版的主线是**把"谁有权决定"和"谁有权改写"各自收回一处**：只有人能拍板的工具成为一条声明而不是三处分支，会话授权按它被问到的那个主体记录，委派运行需要越过写入围栏时向人发问而不是向派它出来的模型发问；同时一个会话被另一个窗口占用时改为只读打开——租约保护的从来是写回，不是阅读。供应商一侧，DeepSeek 目录、视觉能力与官方价格各自收敛为一份声明，九个逐厂商手写的迁移函数随之退役。界面一侧是一轮以实测为准的整理：阅读列、任务页、导航树的键盘可达、上下文折叠点说出是哪条界限并在读到它的地方修改。自 2.14.1 起 67 个提交。

**升级路径**：无需人工步骤。三平台照旧自更新——Linux 走 `.deb`，Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。DeepSeek 的 flash 模型 id 改为 `deepseek-flash`，已安装的配置由升级改写而非弃置，价格、推理强度等以旧 id 为键的设置随之迁移。此前"只能由人批准"的会话授权若以裸工具名记录，会在下一次遇到时再问一遍——那条规则不是你给出的答案，是记录它的代码替你放宽的。

## 新增

### 权限：只有人能决定的事，是一条声明

- **三处声明合一，并因此补上了前一次修复漏掉的那一半**。"这个工具的授权要读它的主体"此前写在三个地方：`subjectRequiresHuman` 的分支、`subjectScopedTools` 表、以及测试里的一份副本。合并后暴露出一条更早的路径：`install_source` 的 `apply` 拿到 `high:...` 计划时，分级判定返回 Ask，而 Approver 为 nil 时 `unattendedAsk` 直接放行——YOLO 正是以 nil approver 构建的，**高风险自我扩展计划（常驻进程、生命周期钩子、外部服务）在该档下被静默批准，没有人看到过那张计划**。现在成员资格一处声明同时承载三个后果，加第四个工具只是一条表项。
- **「不再询问」只对它被问到的那个主体生效**。`SessionGrantRuleForScope` 只为 bash 保留主体、把文件工具合并为一条 Edit 授权，其余一律落到裸工具名——而裸工具名规则匹配该工具此后的一切主体。实测：给 `/ws/internal/foo/bar.go` 的一次放行同时覆盖 `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` 与 `/ws/.git/hooks/pre-commit`；给一份低风险安装计划的放行覆盖高风险计划。
- **旧形态的会话授权不再生效**。上一条只停止了新的记录。已记录的那些同样覆盖一切，而它们不是用户写下的句子——用户当时看的是一份计划、一条路径。规则里没有主体，迁移无从谈起，所以判定移到读取侧：主体敏感工具的裸授权被拒绝，问题再问一次。**用户自己写在配置里的 `allow = ["install_source"]` 是他自己的句子，不在此列。**
- **委派运行可以请求扩大写入围栏，且只有人能回答**。`write_paths` 只能在开工前声明，于是每一次"读了才知道要动哪里"都是终局：工具拒绝，运行自行绕开或放弃。现在它发问——问用户，不问父代理，因为父代理是模型，模型批准自己的触及范围不构成围栏。走的是权限这条轴（扩权是一种能力），在所有 fallback 档位下都回到人，与 `install_source` 同一把尺。`WriteGrant` 把 declared 与 granted 分开：只有 declared 那一份能在开工前证明互不重叠，调度读 `Declared()`、审计读 `Scope()`，越出声明集的写入按调用时长向调度器预留（try 而非 wait——持有路径的调用内再等待正是死锁的形状）。

### 会话与运行时

- **被另一个窗口写着的会话，改为只读打开**。租约存在是为了两个窗口不把同一份转录互相覆盖：各自持有内存副本，`Hub.Close` 与 resume 都会在退出时快照，后关的那个抹掉前一个的产出。那是真实的丢失路径，但它完全是关于**写回**的。现在面板改为 attach：租约空闲则取得，被活跃运行时持有则以无租约、无写入权限打开。守卫没有移动——回合准入走 `ensureWriteAuthorityReady`，每一次保存走 `requireWriteAuthorityForSave`，没有租约就什么都递不出去。
- **一个活过了自己窗口的内核，不再攥着那个窗口的会话**。排查"为什么打不开这个会话、它说被别处占用"时发现：本机有四个 Reasonix 内核存活，其中一个在派生它的应用消失后又活了十天，它们
